dct_description_sm: These 1 meter indexed contours were derived from the 1 meter DEM raster acquired in 2009 by the Ontario Natural Resources Airborne Lidar Survey. The DEM was smoothed and clipped to the Kingston boundary before the Contours were generated. Contours have been Indexed at 2, 5 and 10m intervals for easy Labeling and Symbology.
